Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer did not follow the Planner’s instruction to open and verify credible sources, instead relying on search-result snippets. This behavior later surfaced an incorrect snippet (“Keith Urban returned as the host”) and led to repeated loops without proper citation or confirmation. The failure to click into authoritative pages and extract explicit, sourced statements risked misidentifying the host and impeded efficient resolution.
